slides.title: Ethiopia's navy chief calls for sea-port talks with neighbours
What he said
slides.body: Vice Adm. Kindu Gezu: return to a sea port is "inevitable"; dialogue with regional countries is essential.

slides.title: Who attended
slides.body: A maritime security forum with delegates from Yemen, Oman, Djibouti, Somaliland and Puntland.

slides.title: What is not stated
slides.body: The report names no port or country. Single outlet, not independently verified.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica · Oct 30, 2026
